note: ADR 1124: a named callback (memo compute, onSettled, effect compute) whose only other entry is a whole element of a spread-free array literal the standard forEach runs through an only-called parameter: clean where that forEach runs silently (a handler, a timer; Chrome quiet), uncertifiable in the body or an apply (Chrome warns, covered). The twins (map, a non-literal, a parameter reassigned, passed on, called in a nested function, a spread, a second parameter, an alias) stay uncertifiable.
